final_answer: I've built `report.html` (about 229 KB). It's a single self-contained file: all three charts are embedded as PNG images and it doesn't load anything from the internet. Total revenue for 2025 was **11,498,587.33** from **10,000 orders**, so the average order value is **1,149.86**. The month-by-region table shows revenue staying fairly steady at about 0.91–0.99M a month, peaking in November at 1.05M. The ten top products are led by Product-13 (648.6K, about 5.6% of revenue). Electronics (26.5%) and Sports (25.7%) bring in the most revenue, followed by Home (22.4%), Beauty (13.9%) and Books (11.5%). One thing I fixed: pandas reads the region code "NA" (North America) as a blank value by default, which would have dropped about 25% of rows (2,519 orders) from the region figures. I read it as a real region instead, so all four regions are included, and the report notes what "NA" means. The data had no truly missing values or duplicate orders, and the revenue column matches quantity × price × (1 − discount) to within a few cents of rounding. The data runs from 1 Jan to 28 Dec 2025, so December may be missing a few days.
